reasons.claim: The opening lists three co-transmitters before 'قالوا' followed by Ismail, al-Ala, his father, and Abu Hurayra as the last link before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن أيوب، وقتيبة، وابن، حجر قالوا حدثنا إسماعيل، عن العلاء، عن  أبيه، عن أبي هريرة،

reasons.claim: Under ruling 3, the opening question gives the asker al-Halabi followed by Abu Abd Allah as the last link, while the Prophet quoted inside the answer is not a link.
reasons.quote: وَ سَأَلَ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ

reasons.claim: Both readers trace the single linear chain from Muhammad b. Sallam through Yahya b. Urwa and Urwa to Aisha as the last link before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن سلام، أخبرنا مخلد بن يزيد، أخبرنا ابن جريج، قال ابن شهاب أخبرني يحيى بن عروة، أنه سمع عروة، يقول قالت عائشة

reasons.claim: The single linear chain runs from Abd Allah b. Muhammad al-Sa'igh through the bare relation 'أبي' and Anas b. Malik to Salman al-Farisi as the last link before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: أنه سمع أنس بن مالك يقول: حدثني سلمان الفارسي (رحمه الله)، أنه سمع نبي الله

reasons.claim: The first two taḥwīl branches each run to their own father link, with the dash-bounded gloss left out and the Prophet ending each branch.
reasons.quote: عن ابن بريدة، أراه عن أبيه، - الشك من أبي خيثمة - عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ح .

reasons.claim: The third branch has three co-transmitters joined by 'جميعا' before Abd al-Razzaq, yielding five routes in total.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا ابن أبي عمر، ومحمد بن رافع، وعبد بن حميد، جميعا عن عبد الرزاق

reasons.claim: The closing cross-reference to Abi Sinan's report is a variant remark under ruling 6, not a route.
The first taḥwīl branch stops at Umar b. Nafi before 'ح', meeting the second branch which also reaches Umar b. Nafi.
reasons.quote: حدثنا عمر بن نافع، ح وحدثني أمية بن بسطام

reasons.claim: The closing back-reference 'بإسناد عبيد الله' is written once after both branches reach Umar b. Nafi (confirmed by the dual 'وألحقا'), so it is a shared_tail for both routes rather than belonging only to the second branch.
reasons.quote: عن عمر بن، نافع بإسناد عبيد الله ‏.‏ مثله وألحقا التفسير في الحديث

notes: Both taḥwīl branches meet at Umar b. Nafi and share the back-reference 'بإسناد عبيد الله' as shared_tail; the gloss '- يعني ابن زريع -' and wording remark 'مثله وألحقا التفسير في الحديث' are excluded.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Abu Nu'aym through Urwa to Aisha as the last link, with Abd Allah b. Ubayy b. Salul named only inside her gloss.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو نعيم، حدثنا سفيان، عن معمر، عن الزهري، عن عروة، عن عائشة

reviews.question: a rescript from an Imam (and cited book) copied with no transmitter

reasons.claim: The compiler explicitly states that he found a copy of the rescript in some books and narrated it from no one, so there is no isnad; if the unruled question treated the Imam as a link without a transmitter, 'الرِّضَا عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَى' would be the sole link, otherwise no_chain holds.
The document is introduced as a copy of a rescript from al-Rida Ali b. Musa found in unnamed books.
reasons.quote: وَوَجَدْتُ فِي بَعْضِ الْكُتُبِ نُسْخَةَ كِتَابِ الْحِبَاءِوَالشَّرْطِ مِنَ الرِّضَا عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَى‏ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Hannad through Abd Allah b. Dinar to Ibn Umar as the last link.
reasons.quote: حدثنا هناد، حدثنا وكيع، عن سفيان، عن عبد الله بن دينار، عن ابن عمر،

reasons.claim: The closing 'وفي الباب عن' list and Abu Isa's grading remark are not routes of this report.
reasons.quote: وفي الباب عن عمرو بن عوف المزني وابن عمر وعمارة بن أوس وأنس بن مالك
